reviews.review:
Overall I like this game, it’s a nice take on Minecraft prisons but no pay to win

The pros are:
- It’s easy to play
- Active development as of writing this review
- A discord to contact the dev where he is active to answer questions and whatnot
- You can build a sense of power like you are making some decent progress
- Min Maxing gear can be autistically satisfying 

The not so pro:
- He uses the RuneScape XP system to my current knowledge and is far too much of an ask currently to feasibly 100% this game
- It can become very tedious when your mining is greatly slowed by block toughness (however he said a planned rework is coming so I’ll adjust this accordingly)

It’s cheap, cheerful and I’d recommend giving it a try. 

(Just do note you will probably never 100% it due to the absurd RuneScape formula for skill XP)
